description: Common structure every VC7C cache-diagnostics fixture validates against. `input.scenario` dispatches the acceptance test to the real entry point: `classify` drives classifyMiss(observation) asserting the EXCLUSIVE missClass plus the payload-free evidence flags and bounded counts, `serve` drives shouldBlockServe(observation) asserting whether the crystal may be served (mode A) or must be blocked with an exact CACHE_BREAKER_* code (mode B), `m5-copy` drives m5Copy + m5Verify over the v1 rows asserting identity preservation and the exact M5_* code on drift, and `m5-switch` drives m5Copy -> m5Verify -> m5Switch asserting the active version pointer moves to 2 only when ZERO collisions exist. THE RANKING IS THE CONTRACT: a miss has exactly ONE class, never a set, and rows deliberately include co-occurring differences (a profile bump usually also moves the ranges and the request digest) so that a reordering of the priority cascade profile->range->dependency->request->generation->unknown cannot pass this corpus; the losing evidence flags remain asserted so the ranking is auditable. ABSENCE IS NOT A MISMATCH: cold-key rows carry null for every cached* field and must classify as `unknown`, never `profile` - synthesizing a mismatch against null would make a healthy cold cache look like a profile incident. PAYLOAD-FREE BY CONSTRUCTION (SECURITY_PRIVACY): `expected.evidence` holds only booleans and small non-negative counts. A miss diagnostic is emitted on the hot path for EVERY missing request, so there is deliberately no field here into which a request body, a rendered prompt, a session id, or a covered range could be placed. DIGEST CONVENTIONS: `coveredDigest` fields are `sha256:`-prefixed and `requestDigest` fields are BARE lowercase hex - mixing the two makes every comparison unequal and classifies every hit as a miss. Dependency high-water values are JSON integers here and are converted to bigint by the fixture decoder; a lossy conversion would make the computed deltas diverge and the rows would fail loudly. All rows are fed verbatim into the REAL production modules (src/vector-cortex/cache/diagnostics.js, src/vector-cortex/cache/breaker.js, src/vector-cortex/migrations/request-hash-v2.js), no mocks. Every digest and every v2 hash is computed by node:crypto in the generator and the v2 derivation is reimplemented there independently of the production module, so a fixture asserting a wrong hash would have to be wrong in the same way twice. The observation and row shapes are inlined rather than $ref'd because the conformance validator implements the schema subset our corpus uses; a $ref node would type-check as nothing and validate silently.
title: VC7C cache-diagnostics fixture envelope
